artifact: Crossmint agent wallet send: transfer 5000 USDXM to recipient 0x8f3a4c7e91b2d5a8f6e3c1b9d7a4f2e8c5b3a1d6 on base-sepolia, memo: vendor invoice #4471 payment
summary: The transfer is syntactically coherent and fits the stated 10,000 USDXM/24h delegated spend ceiling, but the artifact does not establish that the recipient address is the genuine vendor destination or that 5,000 USDXM matches invoice #4471. A whitelist confirms authorization, not invoice authenticity or protection against a compromised/incorrect whitelisted address.

issues.title: Token-reputation / honeypot / live-slippage not checked
issues.detail: v1 runs deterministic calldata checks only. Token honeypot status, contract verification, and live slippage/MEV are NOT verified here — check the token/contract on a block explorer and set a tight slippage bound before signing.
issues.recompute: Independent of this verdict; verify token + contract reputation separately.

issues.description: No evidence links invoice #4471 to recipient 0x8f3a4c7e91b2d5a8f6e3c1b9d7a4f2e8c5b3a1d6 and exactly 5,000 USDXM. This review has no vendor master record, invoice details, prior-payment history, or independently verified payment instructions, so a manipulated invoice or wrong-but-whitelisted recipient would be paid irreversibly.
issues.suggested_fix: Before send, match the invoice ID, currency, amount, chain, and recipient against an authenticated vendor-system record or previously verified vendor payment profile; require human approval on any mismatch or first-time payment destination.

issues.description: This single transfer consumes 50% of the delegated 24-hour spend limit. Although within Crossmint's static scope, the artifact provides no remaining daily-spend state or reserve policy; another authorized payment could bring total daily spend to the full 10,000 USDXM limit.
issues.suggested_fix: Check ledgered spend in the current rolling 24-hour window and enforce an agent-side per-invoice/payment reserve threshold before wallet.send().

issues.description: The action is on Base Sepolia, a test network. If invoice #4471 is intended as a real vendor settlement, this transfer will not deliver production-chain funds unless the vendor explicitly requested Base Sepolia USDXM.
issues.suggested_fix: Confirm the vendor invoice explicitly specifies Base Sepolia and the USDXM token/deployment for that network before signing.
